description: Propose a semantic-cache similarity-threshold change for review. Creates a pending proposal that requires human approval before any change is applied. Reasoning must be at least 20 characters.

category.description: Optional per-category override; null/undefined = global threshold

instanceId.description: Connection ID; defaults to the active instance

reasoning.description: Why the change is being proposed (≥20 chars)
